description:
src/backend.rs:10-13 — calendars re-exports the property enums from
jmap_calendars_types:

    pub use jmap_calendars_types::backend::{
        CalendarEventNotificationProperty, CalendarEventProperty, CalendarProperty,
        ParticipantIdentityProperty,
    };

src/lib.rs:49-53 — the crate-root re-export does NOT include them:

    pub use backend::{
        AddedItem, BackendChangesError, BackendSetError, CalendarsBackend, ChangesResult, GetObject,
        JmapBackend, JmapObject, QueryChangesResult, QueryObject, QueryResult, SetError, SetErrorType,
        SetObject,
    };

A consumer wanting `CalendarProperty` must write
`use jmap_calendars_server::backend::CalendarProperty` — the shorter
`use jmap_calendars_server::CalendarProperty` does not compile.

The canonical mail-server (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs:89-94)
re-exports its seven property enums at the crate root:

    pub use backend::{
        ... EmailProperty, EmailSubmissionProperty, IdentityProperty, MailboxProperty,
        SearchSnippetProperty, ThreadProperty, VacationResponseProperty
    };

What goes wrong for the caller: a backend author writing cookie-cutter
imports across both crates writes
`use jmap_mail_server::EmailProperty;` (works) but must write
`use jmap_calendars_server::backend::CalendarProperty;` (works) — the
path depth diverges by exactly one segment. A search-and-replace from
"jmap_mail_server::EmailProperty" to "jmap_calendars_server::CalendarProperty"
silently produces an unresolvable import.

Once published in 0.1.x, adding the crate-root re-export is non-breaking but
removing the deeper `backend::` re-export later would be a SemVer break. The
inverse (publishing both re-export paths now) doubles the API surface
permanently.

Fix: add the four property enums to the crate-root `pub use backend::{...}`
in lib.rs:49-53, matching the canonical mail-server's re-export depth.
Removing the existing `backend::` path is a future-SemVer concern but does
not need to happen now.

P2 — published-API consistency, not a present-day bug.
title: Property enums re-exported only from backend.rs, not from crate root (diverges from canonical)
